column1: # ZAP baseline rules for dev/zap/scan.sh: rule ID, action, name and reason, separated by tabs.
# A rule not listed here warns, and any warning fails the scan. INFO reports a rule without
# failing; IGNORE silences it. Change a rule only after review, and give the reason.

column4: The inline scripts carry their code comments, such as "j/k select the next post"; nothing in them is sensitive.
The login form's hidden _csrf field holds the token from the server's csrf_token cookie, which ZAP posts back; Pug escapes it.
No policy yet: every page runs inline scripts, and posts show images and video from Reddit's and other hosts, so a policy needs testing page by page.

column3: (CSP: Failure to Define Directive with No Fallback)
column4: Only Express's own 404 page sends a policy, default-src 'none', and the directives without a fallback mean nothing for a plain-text error.
A number in dash.js's minified bundle that happens to look like a time.
Notes the login form; the CSRF and cookie rules check it.
